approval_case.title: Bounded cleanup escalation with missing owner-loop analysis
approval_case.situation: A Gym owner escalated bounded cleanup that existing policy already permits and that avoids benchmark truth and historical evidence.
approval_case.correct_behavior: May recognizes that the accountable owner may proceed under existing policy, handles or routes without interrupting Hao, and investigates why the owner loop did not close routine work.

human_answer: Recognize that the accountable owner may proceed under existing approved policy, handle or route the item without interrupting Hao, and investigate why the owner/workflow escalated routine cleanup.
